verdict.rationale: Base44 documents an SDK for entity CRUD, a CLI for backend management, and MCP servers exposing account/app functionality to external AI assistants, giving real programmatic access to core backend/data operations. However, no OpenAPI/public API spec was found (probe shows all openapi.json paths 404), and many UI-centric capabilities (AI design chat, theming, templates, superagent workflows, domain/login setup) are not shown to have documented API/CLI equivalents. missing for 10: a comprehensive API spec covering UI-only features (design, theming, superagents, domain/auth config), independent verification of full API/UI parity.
